messages:
ellie: tiny mystery spotted: theres a neon pink post-it stuck to the ceiling tile above the kitchenette that says "deploy at dawn" in messy handwriting. did we summon a prophecy or did someone lose a brain cell? :neon_sign:

matt: i wrote that. but not a prophecy! it was a twitter thread experiment gone analog. also apologies for the mess. :sweat_smile:

priya: matt WHAT. is this how we decide release cadence now? post-it divination? :crystal_ball:

doug: last time we relied on in-office augury we accidentally merged a debug log to prod. still emotionally processing. :sob:

ellie: true. the Council of Sticky Notes has a history. remember when the purple post-it declared a snack embargo and half the office went hungry?

matt: i stand by the experiment. we were testing whether physical memes have stronger memetic durability than slack threads. hypothesis: yes.

priya: poll: remove the sticky, leave it, or memorialize it on a tiny plaque? 1 remove, 2 leave (matt gets to keep doing this), 3 plaque + lore writeup.

ellie: 3 (plaque)

matt: 2 (i deserve artistic license)

doug: 1 (remove before Facilities trips over it)

facilities-bot: Heads up from #facilities: ceiling tiles are periodically inspected. Anything adhered to tiles may be removed during maintenance. If you want a permanent display, please request a hook or a bulletin board here: https://redwood/internal/facilities (auto) :wrench:

priya: ok new compromise: take a high-res photo, put it in the Company Folklore folder, and replace actual sticky with a tasteful postcard. preserves the meme, reduces tile-risk.

matt: i can design the postcard. matts post-it -> limited edition. :art:

ellie: love it. also quick lore note: whoever writes the postcard blurb must include the phrase "deploy at dawn" and a footnote about the Great Debug Merge of '22. canon.

doug: i'll draft a tiny timeline: 1) purple post-it embargo 2) badge of the Thermos of Destiny 3) neon prophecy 4) cookie council formation. keeps historians busy.

priya: bonus: we should create a rotating curator role for office memes. title: "Keeper of Small Things". volunteer?

matt: stepping down after this glorious act. i nominate @ellie.

ellie: honored but humble. will accept 6-month term. responsibilities: preserve weirdness, approve postcard designs, maintain gentle chaos.

facilities-bot: Facilities noted the postcard plan. Please submit a small display request form to the link above to reserve a 6x4 slot by the coffee station. ETA response: 24-48h. (auto) :white_check_mark:

priya: archival plan: i'll upload the photo and the postcard text to the folklore folder. tagline idea: "When in doubt, stick it to the ceiling." (j/k)

doug: also proposing a tiny ceremonial caption plaque: "In honor of impulsive memetics and questionable release decisions." low budget, high history.

matt: promise: no more ceiling adhesives. postcard-only future. also: limited-edition magnet set, anyone? :magnet:

ellie: thread concluded. this is now official lore. future interns will find it and we will become a myth. :scroll:
